quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 消融实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: The first is a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and the second is a simple, position-wise fully connected feed-forward network.
claim: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络两个子层，并围绕每个子层使用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，模型在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence
claim: 由于模型不含循环与卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1]。

quote: The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型大小与图像块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: Layernorm (LN) is applied before every block, and residual connections after every block.
claim: 编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个块前使用 LayerNorm、块后使用残差连接 [S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
claim: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的二维图像块，展平后经可训练线性投影映射为 patch embeddings，并加入位置嵌入，形成序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。

quote: RAG achieves an accuracy within 2.7% of this model, despite being supplied with only the claim and retrieving its own evidence.
claim: 在 FEVER 上，RAG 的 3 路分类结果与最优模型相差 4.3% 以内，2 路分类相差 2.7% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修改记忆、难以提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修改记忆、难以提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: a retriever $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ with parameters $\eta$ that returns (top-K truncated) distributions over text passages given a query $x$
claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
claim: 所有实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为 100 词的不重叠块，共 2100 万文档，使用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上进行了更多研究，该数据集包含 5 万张训练图像和 1 万张测试图像，共 10 类 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 此外，作者提到深层普通网络优化困难的原因将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络深度增加，准确率会先饱和然后迅速退化，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，而是深层网络难以优化 [S1.p3]。

quote: The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含 1000 类，模型在 128 万张训练图像上训练，在 5 万张验证图像上评估，并报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升，1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试错误为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 为解决可读性和语言混杂问题，作者进一步提出 DeepSeek-R1，采用整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调的多阶段训练框架 [S1.p3]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思、验证和探索替代方案等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: These distilled models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, surpassing the performance of their original instruction-tuned counterparts.
claim: 蒸馏后的小模型在推理基准上超越了其原始指令微调版本 [S1.p4]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).
claim: 作者在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。

quote: for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge.
claim: 此外，纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励攻击挑战，对于无法由可靠奖励模型有效评估的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放问题 [S6.p9]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，最简单的实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；二是预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束符或追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1).
claim: 评估使用三个推理基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），采用温度 0 的贪婪解码，测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用三个推理基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），采用温度 0 的贪婪解码，测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: CHMath (2024 Chinese High School Mathematics League), Gaokao (China’s 2024 College Entrance Exam), Kaoyan (Chinese Graduate School Entrance Exams), and GradeSchool (our new elementary mathematics benchmark).
claim: 评估框架包含域内和分布外两部分：域内使用 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]；分布外使用 OlympiadBench、CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool、Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we implemented a rule-based scoring system that calculated weighted metrics for each dimension.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并基于规则评分系统按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法和自适应粒度四个维度打分，选出最高分的 800 个样本构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we utilize a learning rate of 5.0e-6 with a cosine decay schedule.
claim: 训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 和 FlashAttention-2，学习率 5.0e-6，余弦衰减，省略 warmup，训练 15 个 epoch，batch size 为 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples, with only marginal increases between LIMO-800 and LIMO-1k2 (+0.9 on AIME24, -0.2 on MATH500)
claim: 消融分析显示，推理链质量越高模型性能越好，L5 在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；仅改变问题选择即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，达到 51.5%，Advanced-500 训练的模型在 MATH500 上达到 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；预训练骨干影响显著，LIMO（基于 Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点（63.3% 对 9.2%），在 MATH500 上高 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；模型规模增大时 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异微小（95.6% 对 94.8%），AIME24 上为 63.3% 对 68.3%，可能存在饱和点 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升至 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减，2k 最佳（AIME24 69.6，MATH500 95.8）但相对 1.6k 提升很小 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: All evaluations maintain a 32,768 token maximum output length.
claim: 所有基准采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，较大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的基准生成 4 个样本（temperature=0.6）计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计 LM agent 与计算机之间的接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂任务上的表现 [S1.p1]。

quote: about half ( $52.0$ %) of unresolved instances fall into the Incorrect Implementation or Overly Specific Implementation categories
claim: 多数失败属于错误实现，约一半（52.0%）未解决实例属于 Incorrect Implementation 或 Overly Specific Implementation [S5.SS2.p6]。

quote: The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
claim: 对比基线包括非交互式 RAG 基线和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
claim: 消融实验显示，Iterative search 界面在搜索结果多时表现甚至差于无搜索工具（15.7% 降至 12.0%），而缺少文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4]。

quote: All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
claim: 所有结果基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。

quote: we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K.
claim: 评估任务为 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本直接推理能力 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
claim: 作者承认，为解决问题而做了一些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术是否适用于从零开始训练的模型，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。

quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
claim: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型 [S5.p1]。

quote: Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心策划的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
claim: 此外，作者指出无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且没有防止有害或有偏推理模式的保障 [Sx1.p1]。

quote: • Llama 3: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Llama-3-70B-Instruct. • Gemma: Gemma-2B, Gemma-7B. • Pythia: Pythia-70M through Pythia-12B (eight models in total).
claim: 此外还在 Llama 3、Gemma、Pythia 等不同规模（70M-70B）和训练阶段的模型上，于 MATH 和 CodeContests 上验证趋势 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: 1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law.
claim: 覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题用正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从样本中选出最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: Of the 122 problems in the test set that have Python3 solutions, we find that 35 problems have “correct” solutions that fail the corresponding tests.
claim: 此外，软件任务的验证器存在缺陷：SWE-bench Lite 中 11.3% 的问题有 flaky 测试，CodeContests 中 122 个有 Python3 解的问题里有 35 个的“正确”解无法通过测试 [S4.SS2.SSS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS2.p3]。

quote: For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.
claim: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 各取 128 个随机测试题，MiniF2F-MATH 取 130 个形式化 MATH 问题，CodeContests 取 140 个无图像标签的测试题，SWE-bench Lite 用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 配合 Moatless Tools 框架 [S2.p4][S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模标注数据限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少量示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与或偶尔超过由微调模型保持的最优结果 [S1.p11]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
claim: 评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]；具体包括少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: This may include fill-in-the-blank tasks, tasks that involve looking back and comparing two pieces of content
claim: 作者还指出模型存在结构性限制，因为实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、回看比较两段内容或需要重读长文后生成极短答案的任务表现 [S5.p3]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC
claim: 同时，论文发现部分任务即使对 GPT-3 而言少样本表现仍然不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: Llama 3 70B also outperforms Mixtral 8x22B.
claim: 在预训练基准上，Llama 3 8B 几乎在所有类别上优于竞争模型，70B 大幅超越 Llama 2 70B 和 Mixtral 8x22B [S5.SS1.SSS1.p4]。

quote: We performed an extensive series of evaluations of Llama 3, investigating the performance of: (1) the pre-trained language model, (2) the post-trained language model, and (3) the safety characteristics of Llama 3.
claim: 论文对预训练模型、后训练模型和安全特性进行了广泛评估 [S5.p1]。

quote: We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础模型 Llama 3，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并探索通过组合式方法集成图像、视频和语音等多模态能力 [S1.p3][S2.p4]。

quote: We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.
claim: 研究动机在于基础模型是许多现代 AI 系统的基础，而开发高质量基础模型的关键杠杆是数据、规模和复杂度管理 [S1.p1][S1.p4]。

quote: We leverage MMLU and MMLU-Pro to evaluate Llama 3’s capability on knowledge-based question answering.
claim: 后训练评估包括通用知识（MMLU、MMLU-Pro）、指令遵循（IFEval）、编程（HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E）、多语言（多语言 MMLU、MGSM）、数学推理、长上下文和工具使用等基准，并进行了大规模人类评估 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS3.p2][S5.SS2.SSS4.p1][S5.SS2.SSS5.p1][S5.SS2.SSS6.p1][S5.SS2.SSS7.p1][S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 在 MMMU 上 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实世界应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在 Charades-STA 上 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU 分数，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

claim: 结合亲和力评估使用抗溶菌酶抗体 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2209 个可变域变体深度突变扫描，以及来自 7 个抗体的 124 个蛋白语言模型引导亲和力成熟变体 [S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS3.p3]。

quote: AntiFold also outperformed AbMPNN for CDRH3 (60% vs 56%), all remaining CDR regions (75-84% vs 63-76%), and most FR regions (87-94% vs 85-89%, Figure S3).
claim: 在实验结构测试集上，AntiFold 的 CDRH3 氨基酸恢复率相比原始 ESM-IF1 有大幅提升（60% vs 43%，p < 0.005），并在 CDRH3（60% vs 56%）、其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）上优于 AbMPNN [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
claim: 模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness
claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不含和含显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
claim: 在口袋条件生成中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: This proficiency is demonstrated through successful applications in downstream tasks, including learning the distribution of 3D molecules, generating 3D conformations and the generation of molecules with targeted binding affinity to specific proteins.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是如何用语言模型统一处理 3D 分子设计任务，包括 3D 分子生成、给定分子图的构象生成以及口袋条件分子生成 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ (see Section S11.1), lower than dedicated models directly trained on experimental data
claim: 与实验相比，Gibbs 自由能在 1000 K 以下达到 15 meV/atom 的 MAE，优于专门在实验数据上训练的模型 [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: with only 30 configurations sampled from an ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectory with rev-PBE0-D3 level of theory, MatterSim can be efficiently fine-tuned and the resultant model (indicated as finetune-30 model) reaches the same performance as the model trained from scratch with all 900 configurations
claim: 通过微调，仅需 30 个构型即可达到从头训练 900 个构型的性能，数据效率提升 30 倍 [S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: the first-principles supervisor offers the deep learning model supervision signals relating to energies, forces, and stresses on the given structures at the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) level of theory with Hubbard U correction for select materials
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习框架，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: Currently, the model only supports the native prediction of energy, forces, and stresses.
claim: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前使用半局域原子相互作用描述，长程相互作用主要依赖消息传递或注意力权重更新，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相系统）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。

quote: marking a ten-fold increase in accuracy compared with previous efforts
claim: MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的能量 MAE，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。

quote: We evaluate the MD stability of the well-studied MOF-5, recorded to be stable up to temperatures of 723 K
claim: 此外在 MOF-5 上评估不同温度下的 MD 稳定性，并用 Widom 插入评估 Mg-MOF-74 的 CO2 吸附 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In addition to the substantial decreases in forcefield error, diffusion pretraining also makes training more stable
claim: 扩散预训练普遍带来 17% 到 70% 的改进，并使训练更稳定 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.F2]。

quote: Secondly, the base models are used to initialize a Neural Network Potential which predicts the energy, forces and stress of systems and is trained in a supervised manner.
claim: 训练分两阶段：先以基态材料数据做去噪扩散预训练，再微调为预测能量、力和应力的神经网络势 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: To investigate the adsorption properties of Mg-MOF-74 at low pressures, we use Widom insertion using Orb-D3 to compute the heat of adsorption and free energy landscape of $\text{CO}_{2}$.
claim: 此外在 MOF-5 上评估不同温度下的 MD 稳定性，并用 Widom 插入评估 Mg-MOF-74 的 CO2 吸附 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Here, we show that Orb produces stable MD trajectories for MOF-5 across a range of different temperatures.
claim: 在 MOF-5 上 Orb 在 300-800 K 产生稳定轨迹，并复现了实验观察到的苯撑环动力学 [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We then repeat a variable number of cycles of error correction, during which measure qubits extract parity information from the data qubits to be sent to the decoder.
claim: 表面码操作包括将数据量子比特制备在X_L或Z_L基态，重复纠错循环提取奇偶信息，并在每个综合征提取后运行数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）[S2.p3]。

quote: In total, we execute $2\times 10^{10}$ cycles of error correction comprising 5.5 hours of processor execution time.
claim: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导处理器上进行，105量子比特处理器用于距离-7表面码，72量子比特处理器用于距离-5表面码和距离-29重复码 [S1.p3][S4.p2]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文旨在实现并验证表面码量子纠错在物理错误率低于阈值条件下的运行，从而展示逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制的特性 [S1.p1]。

quote: However, at code distances $d\geq 15$, we observe a deviation from exponential error suppression at high distances culminating in an apparent logical error floor of $10^{-10}$.
claim: 距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间获得错误抑制因子Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现偏离指数抑制，逻辑错误下限约为10^-10，由约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: Our repetition code experiments also identify a noise floor at an error rate of $10^{-10}$ caused by correlated bursts of errors.
claim: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩大当前处理器规模实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。

quote: When running cobaya, we rely on the Boltzmann code CAMB for theoretical cosmology calculations.
claim: 使用cobaya进行贝叶斯推断，结合CAMB计算理论宇宙学，并采用Metropolis-Hastings MCMC采样 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p2][S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: We find $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.293\pm 0.015,\\ w&=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$
claim: 在w CDM模型中，DESI BAO单独给出w=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13} [S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: For all other tracers, we quote results in $D_{\mathrm{M}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$ and $D_{\mathrm{H}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$, and provide the value of the correlation between them, $r$.
claim: 论文采用BAO作为标准尺，通过测量星系、类星体和莱曼α森林示踪物的两点关联函数来约束D_M/r_d、D_H/r_d或D_V/r_d [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS3.p7]。

quote: Such tensions, if not due to unaccounted systematics, may indicate new physics beyond $\Lambda$ CDM.
claim: 研究动机在于暗能量动力学尚未被严格检验，且ΛCDM模型内存在哈勃张力等统计显著性的张力，可能指示超出ΛCDM的新物理 [S1.p3]。

quote: However, we repeat the caveat that the limits are substantially relaxed in more extended dark energy models that affect the background geometry, such as those in Section 5.
claim: 作者指出，中微子质量上限强烈依赖于∑mν的先验选择，且在扩展暗能量模型中显著放宽 [S7.SS1.p7][S7.SS1.p9]。

quote: we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$, where $\rho_{0}$ is the gas density at the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$, and the power-law index ranges $0<\gamma<2$.
claim: 在红外波段，模型采用径向密度分布 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^-γ，通过平衡尘埃加热与热发射冷却计算尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度，其中外半径由柱密度约束使 AV≈3 mag 确定 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。

quote: These results agree well to the mean value of the dust mass $\langle M_{\rm dust}\rangle\simeq 1.6^{+4.8}_{-0.9}\times 10^{4}~M_{\odot}$ estimated using NIRCam images of LRDs.
claim: 此外，模型估计的尘埃质量与 NIRCam 图像估计值一致 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$. In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.
claim: 模型结果表明，采用猎户座星云消光律的 SED 能再现 LRD 特征性 V 形 SED，在 λ≳3000-4000 Å 产生红色连续谱，并在紫外波段保持 β_UV~-2 的平坦谱形，而其他消光律则无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。

quote: In the left panel of Figure 4, we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.
claim: 在红外部分，模型计算不同气体密度 n0（1 至 10^3 cm^-3）和密度斜率 γ 下的 SED，并与 JADES 和 COSMOS-Web 的 LRD 堆叠测光数据以及 SCUBA 和 ALMA 非探测上限比较 [S3.p6][S3.p7]。

quote: The attenuated flux density reproduces a red continuum component at $\lambda\gtrsim 3000-4000~{\rm\AA}$ with a slope of $\beta_{\rm opt}\gtrsim 0$
claim: 模型结果表明，采用猎户座星云消光律的 SED 能再现 LRD 特征性 V 形 SED，在 λ≳3000-4000 Å 产生红色连续谱，并在紫外波段保持 β_UV~-2 的平坦谱形，而其他消光律则无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。

quote: It is more convenient to define an entanglement marker by using $D=\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]/3$
claim: 作者定义纠缠标记 D = tr[C]/3，可实验测量为 D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩，其中 ⟨cos φ⟩ 是带电轻子方向经洛伦兹变换到 t\bar{t} 静止系及各自母顶夸克静止系后夹角余弦的平均值 [S1.p9]。

quote: the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
claim: 论文利用顶夸克与反顶夸克之间的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠效应 [S1.p2]。

quote: A minimum of two jets is required, and at least one of them must be identified to originate from a $b$ -hadron
claim: 事件选择要求恰好一个电子和一个缪子且电荷相反，至少两个喷注且至少一个被标记为源自 b 强子 [S1.SS2.p1]。

quote: the information about the polarizations and spin correlations of the short-lived top quarks is transferred to the decay leptons
claim: 由于顶夸克寿命极短，其自旋信息传递给衰变产物，因此可通过测量带电轻子在母顶夸克静止系中的夹角来提取自旋关联 [S1.p7]。

quote: the observed and expected significances with respect to the entanglement limit are well beyond five standard deviations
claim: 在信号区，相对于纠缠极限的观测和期望显著性均远超五个标准差，且不依赖于用于将纠缠极限修正到基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。

quote: Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是如何对一维拓扑超导体中马约拉纳零能模所编码的费米宇称进行投影测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: We interpret these $h/2e$ -periodic bimodal oscillations and RTS in ${\tilde{C}}_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ as originating from switches of fermion parity.
claim: 在双模出现的磁通值处，时间演化呈现随机电报信号，切换间隔服从特征时间 τ_RTS ≈ 2 ms 的指数分布 [S3.p3]。

quote: For device A, the relevant regime is in the neighborhood of $B_{\parallel}=$1.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$$ and $V_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle WP1}}=$-1.832\text{\,}\mathrm{V}$$.
claim: 器件 A 的相关区间在 B_∥ = 1.8 T 和 V_WP1 = -1.832 V 附近 [S3.p2]。

quote: we observe oscillations in the kurtosis $K(C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}})$ of the $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ time trace with a period of $1.7(\pm 0.2)\text{\,}\mathrm{mT}$
claim: 作者观察到量子电容的 h/2e 周期双模分布，其周期 1.7(±0.2) mT 与器件几何下产生 h/2e 磁通的预期值一致 [S3.p2]。

quote: The robustness against errors and simplicity of control offered by this approach make measurement-based topological qubits a promising path towards utility-scale quantum computation
claim: 论文要解决的问题是如何对一维拓扑超导体中马约拉纳零能模所编码的费米宇称进行投影测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: First we show the velocity autocorrelation functions (VAFs) of the Buckingham and MACE models in figure 3, with the resultant densities of states (DOS) of each included as insets.
claim: 此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。

quote: The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
claim: 作者还提到，MACE 势的计算负载高于经典两体势 [S4.p1]，且通过专门针对 LiF 熔融相、使用更多训练数据的专用势可以获得更好的结果 [S4.p1]。

quote: In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system. For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
claim: 此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 无法采用更大体系来增加计算截断半径以观察 RDF 峰进一步衰减并趋于 1 [S3.p5]。

quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
claim: 作者将三种计算模型（MACE、BHM、Buckingham）得到的黏度与实验数据进行比较 [S3.p1]。

quote: In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms
claim: 体系大小为 N=512 原子，MACE 模拟的墙钟时间通常比基于经典势的 CPU DL_POLY 计算长一个数量级 [S2.p3]。

quote: but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets
claim: 论文旨在利用深度学习从 Kepler 光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大样本和复杂光变曲线上耗时且难以应用的问题 [S1.p2]。

quote: First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
claim: 训练分两步：先在 Kepler 样本上做自监督对比预训练，再用模拟数据监督训练 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: It is not clear which result is better in general.
claim: 作者还指出，对于光变周期性发生剧烈变化的样本，模型通常给出“平均”预测，哪种结果更好尚不明确 [S5.SS2.SSS5.p3]。

quote: The trend of high confidence and low error, which can be easily seen in the figure, implies that the model was able to infer which samples are ”harder” for it to determine the stellar properties.
claim: 模型置信度与绝对误差呈高置信度低误差的趋势 [S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
claim: 作者指出，经典方法无法为预测提供不确定性估计，而这对评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。
